startUrls.title: Sitemap URLs
startUrls.description: XML sitemap or sitemap index files to read, e.g. https://example.com/sitemap.xml

followIndexes.title: Follow sitemap indexes
followIndexes.description: When a sitemap is a <sitemapindex>, also read the child sitemaps it points to.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs
maxUrls.description: Hard cap on URL records returned per run. Compute cost scales with this.

includeGlobs.title: Include patterns
includeGlobs.description: Keep only URLs matching at least one glob, e.g. https://example.com/blog/*. Empty = keep all.

excludeGlobs.title: Exclude patterns
excludeGlobs.description: Drop URLs matching any glob, e.g. */tag/*. Applied before include patterns.
